FX-PPSQ-001.says: Textured Square with no texture: a square in the Color Map's colour, where FX-PPLANE-002 draws its disc.

FX-PPSQ-002.says: Textured Square with the dot texture: its red, green, blue and white quarters, upright, the red at the top left.

FX-PPSQ-003.says: Initial Rotation 360: the square turned by its own random amount.

FX-PPSQ-004.says: Rotation Speed 90 a second: at 10.8 frames old, turned about 40 degrees clockwise.

FX-PPSQ-005.says: Rotation Speed keyed from -180 at frame 0 to 180 at frame 24: read at the particle's birth, so it turns anticlockwise for life.

FX-PPSQ-006.says: The 20 by 12 texture on the square: taken down a level, its blue checker greying.

FX-PPSQ-007.says: Two textured squares, Composite: the newer over the older.

FX-PPSQ-009.says: The two, Screen, over the drawing (Composite With Original on), Max Opacity 70.

FX-PPSQ-010.says: The textured square faded out over its life (Opacity Map Fade Out).

FX-PPSQ-011.says: The texture layer starting at frame 15: at frame 10 nothing is drawn; at frame 20 it is FX-PPSQ-002.

FX-PPSQ-012.says: A texture layer not in the composition, `gone`: the effect is left out, the drawing shows, and the warning every frame.

FX-PPSQ-013.says: FX-PPSQ-002 with the layer moved 3 pixels right.

FX-PPSQ-014.says: A burst of turning textured squares, Rotation Speed 180 and Initial Rotation 360, at frames 12 and 24.

FX-PPSQ-015.says: A tiny textured square, size 3: 1.4 pixels across and fainter, the texture taken down to its last level.

FX-PPSQ-016.says: A large square, size 60, turned by its own random amount (Initial Rotation 360): its corners reach past the disc's radius.

FX-PPSQ-017.says: Particle Type "Textured Square": the word is exact. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-PPSQ-018.says: Particle Type "textured_polygon": not one of the plane's kinds. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
